comment: Third-party projects with code in pjrt_c_api_mtl_plugin.dylib; input of scripts/gen_third_party_notices.py.
Order: the plugin's direct third-party code, XLA, LLVM (and code vendored in LLVM), then alphabetical.
License paths are relative to Bazel's external directory ($(bazel info output_base)/external).
in_binary records the evidence (nm on the dylib against the archives of the link params file, 2026-09-30); it is not printed.
On the link line but with no code in the dylib, so not listed: gRPC, upb, envoy_api, xds, googleapis, cel-spec, protoc-gen-validate.
After a pin bump: update versions, re-check the evidence, and re-run the script with --update.
